title: Remote viewing the inside of the Rendlesham triangular craft

tellings.quote: and I was the one that drew the u that went inside that triangular craft and actually drew the floor plans and the insides and all that.

plain: Lyn Buchanan, an Army sergeant who worked as a remote viewer in the 1980s, says he used the mind-only technique to look inside the triangular craft reported in Rendlesham Forest, a woodland in England beside a British Royal Air Force base called Woodbridge. He tells it first-hand, saying he was the one who drew the craft's floor plans and its insides, which, if true, would mean the unit had a picture of the interior of an unexplained craft.
